name: Deniz Kaplumbağası
scene: a sea turtle swimming through sunlit blue water, its shell made of patterned plates
notes: Oval portrait panel with a diagonally swimming sea turtle, patterned shell plates, four sweeping flippers and alternating blue water bands. Requested target 49–59 panes. Generated with fox and hot-air-balloon design references and the old turtle image; inspected and regenerated once to correct the blue eye, transparent exterior, excess segmentation and shading. Final image has a white exterior and warm subject / blue background separation. Remaining doubts: pane count visually exceeds target; mild fill shading remains; some neighbouring subject panes share a colour and may merge during tracing; eye contacts and a few closely spaced shell junctions require downstream geometry review. No obvious loose line ends or X crossings seen. Design sheet only; not traced, audited or published.
